description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Sample Token Count” on the x-axis and the “Shared Experts for Two Samples” on the y-axis, comparing six different task domains: Intent (orange), Summary (blue), Law (yellow), Translation (purple), Code (gray), and Math (green). The x-axis is logarithmic, ranging from $2^9$ (512) to $2^{20}$ (1,048,576) tokens, with major tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis is linear, spanning from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. The “Intent” line begins near 3.8 at $2^9$, rises to ~5.2 by $2^{12}$, dips slightly to ~5.0 at $2^{14}$, then climbs steadily to ~5.9 at $2^{20}$. The “Summary” line starts at 2.0, climbs steeply to ~4.5 at $2^{11}$, dips to ~4.5 at $2^{14}$, then rises to ~5.9 at $2^{20}$. The “Law” line begins at ~3.6, peaks at ~5.8 at $2^{13}$, dips to ~5.7 at $2^{14}$, then rises to ~6.0 at $2^{20}$. The “Translation” line starts at ~5.1, dips to ~4.7 at $2^{11}$, rises to ~5.7 at $2^{13}$, then plateaus near 5.9–6.0 from $2^{15}$ to $2^{20}$. The “Code” line begins at 2.0, rises gradually to ~3.8 at $2^{13}$, dips to ~3.1 at $2^{14}$, then climbs sharply to ~5.7 at $2^{20}$. The “Math” line starts at ~3.8, rises steadily to ~5.9 at $2^{20}$, with a minor dip around $2^{14}$. All lines generally trend upward, indicating that as sample token count increases, the number of shared experts between two samples also increases, though with varying rates and intermediate fluctuations.
